subject: biology-2
question: In some species of bees, unfertilized eggs develop directly into **haploid** males, while fertilized eggs develop into **diploid** females. Which of the following best classifies this mode of reproduction?

options.text: Budding, in which a new individual grows out of the parent's body.
Parthenogenesis, because an egg develops without being fertilized.
Fragmentation, because the body splits into pieces that each grow.
External fertilization, because eggs are released and met by sperm outside the body.

explanation: The scenario is the defining case of parthenogenesis, in which an unfertilized egg develops into a new individual. A and C describe outgrowths of the parent's body or body pieces growing into new individuals, neither of which occurs here. D involves sperm meeting eggs outside the body, which the stem does not describe.
